title: Ginger Congee
description: Rice cooked far past the point most recipes stop, until the grains dissolve into something between soup and porridge. Plain on purpose — the toppings do the talking.
notes: Freezing the rinsed rice overnight breaks the grains and cuts the cooking time by about a third.

ingredients.name: jasmine rice
ingredients.note: rinsed until the water runs clear

ingredients.name: chicken stock
ingredients.note: or water for a plainer bowl

steps.text: Bring the jasmine rice, chicken stock, sliced ginger, and salt to a boil in a large pot.
Drop to the lowest possible heat and cook uncovered, stirring every fifteen minutes or so.
steps.tip: Stir along the bottom each time — congee catches and scorches without warning.

steps.text: Stop when the grains have broken down and the congee coats the back of a spoon. Loosen with hot water if it has gone too far.
Serve topped with the julienned ginger, spring onions, soy sauce, sesame oil, and a soft boiled egg.
